# M1 CarLift UAE

> Daily car lift service in the UAE operating on the Sharjah–Dubai corridor and intercity routes. Fixed daily and monthly pricing, verified drivers, ladies-only option, door-to-door pickup. Book on WhatsApp: +971 52 148 8011.

## Contact
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 52 148 8011
- Website: https://carlift.ae
- Service area: Sharjah, Dubai, Ajman, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah, Al Ain
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 05:30–21:00 (UAE time)

## Services
- Daily car lift (per-trip booking): https://carlift.ae/services
- Monthly car lift subscription (22 working days, fixed price): https://carlift.ae/monthly-car-lift
- Ladies-only car lift with female drivers: https://carlift.ae/ladies-car-lift
- Carpool (shared ride): https://carlift.ae/carpool
- Pick and drop service: https://carlift.ae/pick-and-drop

## Pricing (indicative, confirm on WhatsApp)
- Sharjah → Dubai: from AED 22/day, AED 500/month
- Sharjah → Business Bay: from AED 26/day, AED 570/month
- Sharjah → JLT: from AED 28/day, AED 600/month
- Sharjah → Dubai Investment Park (DIP): from AED 29/day
- Ajman → Dubai: from AED 27/day, AED 600/month
- Dubai → Al Ain: from AED 34/day, AED 750/month
- Sharjah → Ras Al Khaimah: from AED 31/day

## How booking works
1. WhatsApp or call +971 52 148 8011 with pickup area, destination, and preferred departure time.
2. Get matched with a verified driver on your route and receive a fixed daily or monthly quote.
3. Commute every working day; monthly subscribers travel automatically without rebooking.

## Fleet
Clean, air-conditioned cars (sedans and SUVs) driven by UAE-licensed, verified drivers. No surge pricing; monthly subscribers pay a fixed amount upfront.
